q-0388.answer:
Surah Al-Muminoon (23) — The Believers · 118 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• They will not be successful with Him on the Day of Resurrection; they will not prosper or be saved.
• Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
• They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
• And they who turn away from ill speech
• And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

Surah Yaseen (36) — Yaseen · 83 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Until a time that is known to Allah, may He be glorified and exalted.
• The like of mankind. So, He will re-create them as He created them in the first place.
• He only needs to command a thing once; it does not need to be repeated or confirmed.

Surah Al-Infitaar (82) — The Cleaving · 19 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• What will happen on the Day of Judgement
• No one will be able to benefit anyone else, or help him out of that which he will be in, unless Allah gives permission to whomever He wishes and is pleased with.
• Mankind should not forget about Allah
• The Cause of Deception and alerting to the Fact that Angels record the Deeds of the Children of Adam
• You are only compelled to oppose the Most Generous and meet Him with disobedience, by your rejection in your hearts of the Hereafter, the recompense and the reckoning.

Surah Al-Fajr (89) — The Dawn · 30 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Lord is Ever Watchful
• They do not command that the poor and the needy be treated with kindness, nor do they encourage each other to do so.
• To His company, His reward and what He has prepared for His servants in His Paradise.
• He sent down a torment upon them from the sky and caused them to be overcome by a punishment that could not be repelled from the people who were criminals.
• In abundance. This increases some of them in their wickedness.

This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.
